description: Neo front-agent manifest. Human-facing systems are reached through a stable browser, machine-mail, filesystem, and shell substrate; product procedures are skills rather than dedicated integration schemas — except the essential paxeer-net chain/wallet lane (embedded-wallet custody network-side, writes gated by PaxeerSpendPolicy), which is not browser-replaceable and stays a direct tool surface. Autonomous surfaces still structurally exclude value-moving tools. Machine-mail credentials are injected from the encrypted per-user settings vault or inherited from MACHINEMAIL_API_KEY. The exec server's service registry is isolated to /data/neo/services through MATRIX_EXEC_STATE_DIR.

tools.name: mail_list_mailboxes
tools.description: List the mailboxes this MachineMail API key can access.

tools.name: mail_get_mailbox
tools.description: Get one mailbox and its approval policy.

tools.name: mail_get_inbox
tools.description: List recent inbox items with previews.

tools.name: mail_get_conversation
tools.description: Read a complete email conversation before replying.

tools.name: mail_compose
tools.description: Compose mail with a stable idempotency key. Draft-scoped requests returning pending_approval are successful parked sends and must not be retried.

tools.name: mail_reply
tools.description: Reply in an existing conversation while preserving the thread. Draft-scoped pending_approval is success.

tools.name: mail_get_threading_headers
tools.description: Get threading headers for a conversation when explicit header-level reply construction is required.

tools.name: mail_get_pending_approvals
tools.description: List parked draft-scoped outbound messages awaiting human approval.

tools.name: mail_get_approval
tools.description: Get one pending approval and its authoritative state.

tools.name: mail_search_messages
tools.description: Search mailbox messages without scanning the inbox manually.

tools.name: mail_poll_events
tools.description: Read the ordered mailbox event log after a cursor and derive outbound lifecycle from events.

tools.name: mail_get_usage
tools.description: Read MachineMail usage and limits for deterministic preflight.

tools.name: shell
tools.description: Run a shell command (bash -lc) to completion and return exit code + stdout + stderr. Install deps, build, run scripts, inspect the filesystem. Runs in /workspace by default. For a process that must keep running use service_start. args: command (required), cwd?, timeout_ms?, env?.

tools.name: service_start
tools.description: Start or replace a long-lived background service that keeps running after the call and is respawned on machine restart (web servers, bots, workers). Output captured to a log. args: name (required), command (required), cwd?, env?, autostart?.

tools.name: service_list
tools.description: List supervised services with status (running/stopped), pid, uptime, command, cwd, log file. Read-only.

tools.name: service_logs
tools.description: Read the tail of a service's combined stdout+stderr log to verify or debug it. Read-only. args: name (required), lines?.

tools.name: service_stop
tools.description: Stop a supervised service (SIGTERM then SIGKILL the process group); disables autostart until restarted. args: name (required).

tools.name: service_restart
tools.description: Restart a supervised service from its recorded command and re-enable autostart. args: name (required).

tools.name: rpc_call
tools.description: Direct EVM JSON-RPC read against the Paxeer node (PAXEER_RPC_URL, default public-mainnet.rpcpaxeer.online/evm). Read-only.

tools.name: eth_call
tools.description: Read-only eth_call against a contract. Does NOT send a tx.

tools.name: contract_read
tools.description: Encode a method + eth_call + decode outputs (signature + outputs[]). Read-only.

tools.name: encode_call
tools.description: Pure ABI-encode a method call to 0x calldata. No network, no send. Used to build or inspect calldata.

tools.name: chain_info
tools.description: Paxeer chain id, head block, sync status, RPC URL. Read-only.

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Native PAX balance of an address (defaults to the agent wallet). Read-only.

tools.name: token_balance
tools.description: ERC-20 balance + symbol/decimals for a holder. Read-only.

tools.name: paxscan_get
tools.description: Generic PaxScan/Blockscout v2 GET passthrough (any documented route). Read-only.

tools.name: address_overview
tools.description: PaxScan address info + counters + token balances in one call. Read-only.

tools.name: address_transactions
tools.description: PaxScan transaction list for an address. Read-only.

tools.name: tx
tools.description: PaxScan transaction detail by hash. Read-only.

tools.name: token_info
tools.description: PaxScan token metadata + top holders. Read-only.

tools.name: search
tools.description: PaxScan global search (addresses, tokens, txs, blocks). Read-only.

tools.name: network_stats
tools.description: PaxScan network stats (gas, market, tx counts). Read-only.

tools.name: price
tools.description: Off-chain price for PAX or a bridged major (pax|sol|eth|bnb|sid). Read-only.

tools.name: wallet_info
tools.description: Resolve the agent embedded-wallet address + chain (provisions on first use). Network call to the custody API; no value moves.

tools.name: sign_message
tools.description: EIP-191 personal_sign a message with the agent wallet (proof of identity). Signs network-side; no value moves.

tools.name: transfer
tools.description: Send native PAX or an ERC-20. args: to, amount (human), token?, nonce? (explicit nonce), max_fee_gwei? (fee ceiling). WRITE: signs+broadcasts via the embedded wallet; gated by PaxeerSpendPolicy. A returned tx hash means BROADCAST, not mined. nonce + max_fee_gwei are for stuck-tx replacement: on a NONCE GAP error, a 0-amount self-send at the wedged nonce with higher fees unblocks the queue.

tools.name: approve
tools.description: ERC-20 approve a spender (amount or 'max'). WRITE: signs+broadcasts via the embedded wallet; gated by PaxeerSpendPolicy.

tools.name: contract_write
tools.description: Sign and send a caller-specified contract write. Provide signature+args or raw data, optional value. WRITE: gated by PaxeerSpendPolicy.

tools.name: wallet_layerx_deposit
tools.description: Durable one-call LayerX USDL deposit (approve+depositUSDL, confirmed + credit-verified server-side, idempotent). Get did_claim+amount from layerx_deposit first. Returns action_id; poll wallet_action. WRITE: gated by PaxeerSpendPolicy.

tools.name: wallet_allowance_and_call
tools.description: Durable one-call approve-then-call (raw base units), each leg wallet-confirmed + idempotent. Returns action_id; poll wallet_action. WRITE: gated by PaxeerSpendPolicy.

tools.name: wallet_action
tools.description: Poll a durable action by id: status, tx hashes, LayerX credit, and the interpretation-free error envelope. Read-only (never resubmits a broadcast action).
